title: Spire and Hollow
premise: Ansel Okonkwo, a memory-thief in the magic-outlawed city of Vell, discovers his own face in a century-old book of prophecies beside tonight's date — and beside it, a name he's spent seven years burying: his own. The prophecy names him heir to the Hollow Covenant, the broken pact between the human free cities and the hidden realm of the Spire, and the usurper Malvane will kill any claimant before her armies march. Hunted by inquisitors and haunted by memories he stole from himself, Ansel must gather the covenant's scattered tokens, confront the truth that he erased his own inheritance to escape its burden, and choose between anonymity and justice. In the end, he reforges the covenant not by claiming the throne but by returning every stolen memory — including his own — to the people they belong to, unmaking Malvane's claim and opening the realms at last.
about_author: Edmund Hartwell is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. He writes fantasy about ordinary people caught in machinery older than themselves.

chapters.title: The Date That Wasn't His
chapters.summary: POV: Ansel. A routine theft of a magistrate's memory goes wrong when Ansel glimpses tonight's date inked in a prophecy book — with his own name beneath it. He flees through Vell's rain-slick alleys as inquisitors close in, realizing someone has known his identity for a hundred years. Emotional beat: dread curdling into vertigo as the safe, small life he built dissolves overnight.

chapters.title: What I Stole From Myself
chapters.summary: POV: Ansel. Sheltered by Sefa, a fence who deals in forbidden charms, Ansel deciphers the prophecy and finds the first covenant token hidden inside a memory he doesn't remember stealing — because he stole it from himself. Flashbacks reveal he was the covenant's intended heir and chose oblivion. Emotional beat: grief and self-betrayal; the thief discovering he is also the victim.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Ledger
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ansel and Malvane. Ansel races to recover the remaining tokens while Malvane's armies burn the outlying towns; her chapters reveal she too was denied an inheritance and means to make law itself her weapon. Their paths collide at the Hollow Gate, where Ansel learns the covenant demands a price no throne-holder can pay alone. Emotional beat: rising fury on both sides, converging toward judgment.

chapters.title: Spire and Hollow
chapters.summary: POV: Ansel. At the ruined gate, with Malvane's vanguard arriving, Ansel performs the reforging: he returns every memory he has ever stolen, including his own erased years, letting the crowd of creditors witness what he was. Stripped of secrets, he has nothing left to inherit — which is exactly what the covenant requires. The realms open; Malvane's legal claim collapses. Emotional beat: costly, quiet triumph — justice rendered outside every law.
